content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"user managing my personal task list","i_want":"to edit an existing task and save the changes","so_that":"the task list shows accurate, up-to-date task details","business_description":"The user can update an existing task using the same form used to create tasks, pre-filled with the current values. The backend validates the change (non-empty title of at most 100 characters, Due Date not earlier than Creation Date), stores it, and sets the Last Updated Date. The frontend shows a success or error message and never shows an update as saved before the backend confirms it.","business_value":"Users can correct task details over time, and the stored task data stays valid and traceable through the Last Updated Date.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"An existing task with a valid title and a Due Date not earlier than its Creation Date","when":"The user opens the edit form, changes the title, and submits the form","then":"The backend stores the new title and the task shows the new title in the list after the backend returns success"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form","when":"The user clears the title field and submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating that the title is mandatory is shown"},{"given":"An existing task being edited in the form with a title of 101 characters","when":"The user submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored title is unchanged, and an error message stating the 100-character limit is shown"},{"given":"An existing task with Creation Date 2024-05-10","when":"The user sets the Due Date to 2024-05-09 and submits the update","then":"The backend rejects the update with a validation error, the stored Due Date is unchanged, and an error message is shown"},{"given":"An existing task with a Last Updated Date value of 2024-05-10 00:00:00 UTC","when":"The user changes the title to a valid value and the backend returns success","then":"The backend sets the Last Updated Date to the time of that update, which is later than 2024-05-10 00:00:00 UTC, and the stored value is returned on the next read of the task"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns an error response","when":"The frontend receives the error response","then":"The frontend does not show the task as updated and displays an error message"},{"given":"A task update request where the backend returns a success response","when":"The frontend receives the success response","then":"The frontend displays a success message after the update action"},{"given":"A task ID that does not exist in the database","when":"An update request is sent for that ID","then":"The backend returns a Task Not Found error and no data is changed"}],"edge_cases":["A Due Date equal to the Creation Date is valid, because the rule only rejects Due Dates earlier than the Creation Date.","A title of exactly 100 characters is valid; a title of 101 characters is rejected.","A title containing only spaces is treated as empty only if the PRD defines it so; this is not stated and needs confirmation.","An update request that fails validation or fails in the backend leaves the Last Updated Date unchanged.","Changing the task status also updates the Last Updated Date, but that behaviour is covered by US-change-task-status, not by this story.","The PRD does not state whether the Creation Date can be changed through an update; this story does not allow it unless the team confirms otherwise.","The PRD does not state which fields the edit form must allow changing beyond the title and Due Date; this needs confirmation."],"dependencies":["US-create-task"],"definition_of_done":["The update endpoint returns success only after the stored task is saved with the new values.","The update endpoint sets Last Updated Date on every successful update and leaves it unchanged on rejected updates.","The update endpoint returns Task Not Found for an unknown ID and does not change any data.","The edit form shows the current values of the task before editing.","The frontend shows a success or error message after every update and does not show the task as updated before the backend responds with success.","Automated tests cover the title and Due Date validation rules, Last Updated Date behaviour, Task Not Found, and the frontend success and error states."]},"tasks":[{"key_slug":"task-update-endpoint","title":"[BE] Add update endpoint for a task by ID with validation and Last Updated Date","track":"backend","area":"backend","description":"Add the endpoint that updates an existing task by ID. Validate that the title is non-empty and at most 100 characters, and that the Due Date is not earlier than the Creation Date. Set Last Updated Date on each successful update. Return Task Not Found for an unknown ID, a validation error for invalid input, and a server or database error response for internal failures. Do not change any data when the update is rejected.","size":"M","consumes_api":false,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-0b1853d6","R-244669c0","R-9dc414dc"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Endpoint updates title, Description, Status, Priority and Due Date of an existing task by ID.","Title validation rejects empty titles and titles longer than 100 characters.","Due Date earlier than Creation Date is rejected with a validation error.","Last Updated Date is set on every successful update and is not changed on rejected updates.","Unknown ID returns Task Not Found and changes no data.","Errors use the same simple error response format as the other task endpoints."]},{"key_slug":"task-edit-form","title":"[FE] Reuse task form in edit mode with existing values pre-filled","track":"frontend","area":"frontend","description":"Reuse the task creation form in edit mode. Pre-fill the form with the current task values, submit the changes to the update endpoint, and show a success or error message based on the backend response. Do not show the task as updated before the backend returns success.","size":"M","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":false,"requirement_ids":["R-9b30a145","R-d57336f7","R-ab9e9cb0"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["Edit form opens with the current values of the selected task.","Client-side checks show the title mandatory message and the 100-character limit message.","Submitting calls the update endpoint and waits for the response before changing the displayed task.","A success message is shown after a successful update.","An error message is shown after a failed update and the displayed task is not changed."]},{"key_slug":"task-update-test-suite","title":"[QA] Add test suite for editing an existing task across API and form","track":"qa_general","area":"qa","description":"Automated tests for editing an existing task, covering the update endpoint, the validation rules, the Last Updated Date behaviour, and the frontend success and error states.","size":"S","consumes_api":true,"touches_db":true,"requirement_ids":["R-bc3213df","R-03df7815","R-efe1e5d4","R-0b1853d6","R-d57336f7"],"is_spike":false,"definition_of_done":["API tests cover a successful update, empty title, 101-character title, Due Date before Creation Date, and unknown ID.","API tests confirm Last Updated Date changes on success and does not change on rejected updates.","Form tests confirm success and error messages and that the task is not shown as updated after an error."]}]}
